quote: A driver of a motor vehicle shall: Exercise proper caution upon observing a pedestrian: (1) On or near a highway, street or road; (2) At or near a bus stop or bench, shelter or transit stop for passengers of public mass transportation or in the act of boarding a bus or other public transportation vehicle; or (3) In or near a school zone or a school crossing zone marked in accordance with NRS 484B.363 or a marked or unmarked crosswalk.

activation.condition: Motor-vehicle driver receives an original scripted observation input for a pedestrian in or near a source-reviewed marked or unmarked crosswalk.

obligation.description: Exercise proper caution upon observing the pedestrian.

timing.description: Original observation-input and response history during the crossing encounter.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Exercise proper caution upon observing a pedestrian
judgment_calls_needed.note: No numeric legal caution or near-crosswalk cutoff is supplied.

parameter_refs.name: crosswalk_kind
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: marked or unmarked, proved from original Native map readback
